description: Regular-expression search of the CURRENT source only (HEAD of master for postgres, the default branch elsewhere), like `git grep -E` with grep's line semantics: ^ and $ anchor at line starts and ends, . does not cross lines. PostgreSQL regex syntax (\s, \w, (?i) work). path_glob narrows by SQL LIKE pattern ("src/backend/%.c"), repository by name. Returns up to max_results files (default 50, max 500) with repo_name, file_path, line_no and snippet (its first matching line). For any other commit, branch, tag, major version or date, all matches with context, or history, use code_search with match=regex. Cite path:line with the sha.

path_glob.description: Restrict results to paths matching this SQL LIKE pattern, e.g. "%/src/backend/%.c".

repository.description: Restrict results to this repository name (exact match against ag_repositories.name).

name: regex_search_code
